title: HAXElementSchema
description: Lightweight virtual-DOM description of one element: HAX materializes it with haxElementToNode() (webcomponents elements/utils/utils.js) and produces it from a live node with nodeToHaxElement(). Used for haxProperties `demoSchema` entries, tray / Merlin insertion payloads (`hax-insert-content`), duplicate, and keyboard-shortcut insert snippets. Unknown keys are rejected so typos are caught; put tool-specific data under keys that start with `x-`.

tag.description: Tag name to create: a lowercase HTML tag (`p`, `h2`, `img`) or a custom element (`block-quote`). `iframe` is rewritten to `webview` in sandboxed (desktop) environments.

properties.description: Values to apply to the element, keyed by camelCase property name or dash-case attribute name; keys are dash-cased before use, so `fooBar` and `foo-bar` target the same attribute. Strings and numbers become attributes; `true` sets a boolean attribute and `false` removes it; arrays and plain objects are assigned as element properties instead of attributes. `innerHTML` / `innerText` keys are ignored (use `content`), `on*` event-handler attributes are always stripped, and `srcdoc` is stripped from iframes.

additionalProperties.description: Avoid `null`: it is written as the literal attribute value "null". Omit the key instead.

content.description: Light DOM HTML assigned as the element's innerHTML. Use `slot="name"` on children to target named slots. Defaults to an empty string.

eventName.description: Set by nodeToHaxElement() (default `insert-element`) to tag where the payload came from. Not needed when authoring demoSchema entries.

description.description: Human label for this variant when an element ships several demoSchema entries (for example "Large blue explosion"). Informational; HAX core does not read it.

gizmo.description: Runtime only: haxElementPrototype() attaches the matching gizmo when it builds a payload from search results. Do not author.

^x-.description: Extension key for tool-specific data HAX does not read.
